test_title: PYST 40: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people, A, B, L, M, N, S, and T are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the left of S. Only three people sit between S and B. T sits second to the right of S. Only two people sit between T and M. L sits at some place to the right of A but at some place to the left of N.

How many people sit to the right of L?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people, A, B, L, M, N, S, and T are sitting in a row, facing north.

Only two people sit to the left of S. Only three people sit between S and B.

T sits second to the right of S. Only two people sit between T and M.

L sits at some place to the right of A but at some place to the left of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1b57a5e1d38a612fb87b1e27cd95b7b1d8728f0faa8ad951542f8d8b7a3155c.png] 

Thus, Only people sit to the right of L.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
